facts.fact: CAZOS says the MINTTICS AI bill (86 articles, in public consultation since September 2025) would criminalise algorithmic discrimination and create an AI authority, and the APD's draft revision of Lei 22/11 has an AI chapter (arts. 36-38) banning algorithmic social scoring; neither is in force.
facts.system: MINTTICS AI bill; APD revision of Lei 22/11

facts.fact: CAZOS says Lei n.º 22/11 of 17 June, the data protection law in force, already governs decisions taken by automated means.
CAZOS says the Agência de Protecção de Dados (APD), created by Presidential Decree 214/16, supervises, has sanctioning powers, and is the first regulator to reach automated decisions in Angola.

facts.fact: Portal de TI reports that Angola's Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligência Artificial is in public consultation, and that the country has no AI-specific legislation yet.

facts.fact: APD legal director Njunjulo António says the right not to be subject to automated decisions already exists and that the agency's inspection and audit of AI use rests on data-processing principles of transparency, purpose and lawfulness.

facts.fact: Angola's Ministry of Telecommunications (MINTTICS) put a draft AI law in public consultation from September 2025, with penalties for discrimination, hate via algorithms, privacy violations and harm to the democratic process, and a future AI Authority.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligencia Artificial

facts.fact: PTI reports that the MINTTICS draft AI bill, 86 articles in nine chapters, is in public consultation and gives citizens a right to refuse automated decisions, with risk-assessment duties on AI developers and providers.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligencia Artificial

facts.fact: Maka Angola says Angola's Law No. 6/26 took effect on 4 August 2026 and targets fake accounts, bots, deepfakes and coordinated campaigns, with platform reporting duties and removal orders.
Maka Angola says INACOM, Angola's communications authority, is the regulator under Law No. 6/26, with enforcement and fining powers under Article 25.
